title: Dataq Nexus — Overview
meta_description: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.

blocks.x: The Dataq Software build of Dataq Nexus — Overview: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

Dataq Nexus is the decision infrastructure for high-volume enterprise choices: credit, claims, pricing, triage, fraud, routing. It combines predictive models, business rules and agentic reasoning behind one governed decision API, with champion-challenger testing and full decision replay — so any decision can be reconstructed months later for an auditor, a customer or a court.

Nexus enforces separability by design: models score, policy decides, humans supervise. Risk teams change policy without retraining; data scientists ship models without touching code paths; compliance inspects what actually ran on any given day. It is the platform underneath our decision-intelligence services and the control point for every automated decision we deploy.
